name: final-king
description: Monorepo for three ML web apps: SONAR Shield audio denoising, satellite FEC error-correction, and the portal dashboard that ties them together.

scripts.start: concurrently "npm start --prefix apps/denoise/frontend" "npm start --prefix apps/sat/frontend" "npm start --prefix apps/portal" "python3 apps/denoise/backend/main.py" "python3 apps/sat/backend/main.py"
